comparison_reference.name: Serene Village Revamped by LimeZu
comparison_reference.notes: The published terrain set and Construct 3 autotiles set a comparison for crisp terrain groups and map adjacency. The broader swatches here were assessed as material chips and tile delivery.

professional_quality.evidence: Cobble, wood and shingles have useful structure. Flat soil spots and abstract rock and cloth leave the overall swatch set uneven beside a finished environment pack.
professional_quality.guidance: Compare finish against a named professional reference; explain remaining weaknesses.

readability.evidence: At native size cobble, bark, water, boards and shingles are recognizable. The mauve diagonal swatch also reads as a mineral striation, and soil competes with an irregular spotted fabric reading.
readability.guidance: Identify each subject at native resolution from silhouette and proportions.

pixel_clustering.evidence: Broad patches and repeated shingle and cobble rows stay connected. The few soil chips and bark flecks are anchored in larger value fields rather than floating.
pixel_clustering.guidance: Inspect clusters for noise, isolated pixels, banding and accidental geometry.

color_and_lighting.evidence: Each chip uses controlled hue families. Cool water highlights, warm wood grain and alternating slate facets remain separable at native scale.
color_and_lighting.guidance: Check palette harmony, volume, light direction and controlled contrast.

materials.evidence: Wood has knots and end-to-end grain, yet the three long cloth planes provide no weave or identifiable softness. The soil islands lack convincing compacted or granular structure.
materials.guidance: Explain how each material reads through its structure rather than generic pattern noise.

specialized_design.evidence: Compared with the shared texture primitive, roof courses, cobble joints, bark channels and wood knots carry distinct generator geometry.
specialized_design.guidance: Check anatomy, architecture and characteristic features of the subject.

artistic_detail.evidence: Roof and cobble show clear close-up structure. The comparatively vacant soil and broad striped cloth leave detail uneven across the swatch set.
artistic_detail.guidance: Assess depth, personality and finish beyond a merely acceptable primitive.

originality.evidence: Across the two seed groups the soil spots, leaf clusters, bark streaks, water breaks and stone placements visibly shift. Kind-specific shapes are present beyond palette changes.
originality.guidance: Compare with prior and rejected work; explain new geometry and legitimate reuse.

consistency.evidence: Cobble and roof introduce regular construction detail while soil and fabric are mostly broad color blocks. The different implied scales and detail densities lack a common game-context check.
consistency.guidance: Compare scale, perspective, style and detail density within the intended catalog.

technical_integrity.evidence: The 368 by 232 opaque preview has the intended full-bleed background, 48 colors, one combined component, zero singletons and twenty in-bounds 64 by 48 rectangles.
technical_integrity.guidance: Verify dimensions, transparency, borders, directions and absence of deformation.

game_readiness.evidence: The delivered file is an opaque preview of twenty material patches. It includes no isolated runtime tiles or adjacency metadata, and wrapping behavior remains unverified.
game_readiness.guidance: Verify complete views/states/animations and integration without manual repair.
